content: 1. Duloxetine: The metabolism of duloxetine is affected by hepatic enzyme CYP2D6. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Cobicistat, a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution when used with CYP2D6 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 2. Elagolix: The combination of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases elagolix levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Co-administration of elagolix 200 mg BID with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. Elagolix also decreases the levels of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer, and CYP3A substrates should be monitored if co-administered. Dose adjustments of CYP3A substrates may be necessary. 3. Eletriptan: Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases eletriptan levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Cobicistat, as a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 4. Entecavir: Co-administration with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF may increase toxicity by reducing renal clearance. Caution and monitoring are advised. Toxicity may result from combining emtricitabine and tenofovir with other drugs primarily excreted via glomerular filtration or active tubular secretion. 5. Eplerenone: Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases eplerenone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Cobicistat is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 6. Erlotinib: Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases erlotinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Cobicistat is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 7. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Cobicistat is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 8. Cobicistat is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 9. Eszopiclone: Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases eszopiclone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. The starting dose of eszopiclone should be reduced to 1 mg/day. 10. Ethinyl Estradiol: Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases ethinyl estradiol levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Cobicistat is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 11. Cobicistat is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 12. Etodolac: Co-administration with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF may increase toxicity by reducing renal clearance. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Toxicity may result from combining emtricitabine and tenofovir with other drugs primarily excreted via glomerular filtration or active tubular secretion, including high-dose or multiple-dose NSAIDs. Alternatives to NSAIDs should be considered. 13. Etoposide: Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases etoposide levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Cobicistat is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 14. Alternatives to NSAIDs should be considered. 19. Flecainide: Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases flecainide levels by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Cobicistat, a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution when used with CYP2D6 substrates that may lead to elevated plasma concentrations associated with serious or life-threatening events. 20. Fluoxetine: Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases fluoxetine levels by affecting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. However, it may also decrease fluoxetine levels by affecting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Elvitegravir is a moderate CYP2C9 inducer.
